y-m-16-08.title: Ukuhlola isimangalo sikaHajun 'ukwengeza inombolo efanayo kuyishiya injalo'
y-m-16-08.topic: Ukuqhathanisa osayizi bezingxenyana: ukushintsha inombolo engaphezulu nesihlukanisi ndawonye
y-m-16-08.goal: Nquma isimangalo sokuthi ukwengeza inombolo efanayo enombolweni engaphezulu nesihlukanisi kushiya usayizi wengxenyana ungashintshile ngokubheka ukuthi izibonelo ziyizingxenyana ezinhlobo muni, bonisa ngezibonelo eziphikisayo ukuthi usayizi ushintsha kanjani ezingxenyaneni ezincane kuno-1 nezinkulu kuno-1, bese ulinganisela ukuthi kwenzekani engxenyaneni uma inombolo engeziwe yenziwa inkulu kakhulu.
y-m-16-08.material: UHajun wengeze u-2 enombolweni engaphezulu nesihlukanisi sezingxenyana 4/4 (kane kwezine) no-7/7 (isikhombisa kwesikhombisa). Zaba ngu-6/6 no-9/9, futhi zombili zingu-1, ngakho usayizi wahlala unjalo. UHajun uthe, “Noma wengeza inombolo efanayo enombolweni engaphezulu nesihlukanisi sengxenyana, usayizi wengxenyana uhlala unjalo. Kufana nokuhlukanisa ngenombolo efanayo lapho wehlisa!”

y-m-16-08.s.s1.prompt: Ubheka izibonelo uHajun ahlole zona, uzonquma kanjani isitatimende sikaHajun?

y-m-16-08.s.s1.hint.1: Khetha ingxenyana eyodwa enenombolo engaphezulu nesihlukanisi esihlukile, engeza inombolo efanayo, bese uqhathanisa ngaphambi nangemva.
y-m-16-08.s.s1.o.a: Zombili izibonelo zazilungile, ngakho usayizi uzohlala unjalo njalo, futhi akukho ukuthi kuhlolwe okwengeziwe
y-m-16-08.s.s1.r.a: Kunezibonelo ezimbili ezilungile kuphela, futhi awubhekanga ukuthi izibonelo ezimbili ziyizingxenyana ezinhlobo muni.
y-m-16-08.s.s1.o.b: Kufanele sihlole nezinye izinhlobo zezingxenyana ngaphandle kwalezo uHajun azihlolile
y-m-16-08.s.s1.r.b: Ubhekile ukuthi izibonelo ziyizingxenyana ezinhlobo muni futhi wacabanga ngezinhlobo ezingakahlolwa.
y-m-16-08.s.s1.o.c: Awukwazi ukuqhathanisa usayizi wengxenyana ngokwengeza enombolweni yayo engaphezulu nesihlukanisi, ngakho awukwazi ukunquma
y-m-16-08.s.s1.r.c: Ungabala uqhathanise izingxenyana ngaphambi nangemva kokwengeza. Akusikho ukuthi azikwazi ukuqhathaniswa.
y-m-16-08.s.s1.o.d: Ukwengeza kuyikubala okushintsha izinombolo, ngakho usayizi wengxenyana ubonakala ungashintsha, futhi isitatimende sikaHajun asilungile
y-m-16-08.s.s1.r.d: Esibonelweni sikaHajun usayizi wahlala unjalo. Ukuze uqiniseke ngazo zonke izimo, kudingeka ukuhlolwa okwengeziwe.
y-m-16-08.s.s1.explain: U-4/4 no-7/7 zombili ziyizingxenyana ezinenani elingu-1, ngakho noma wengeza inombolo efanayo, ihlala ingu-1. Njengoba ingxenyana enenombolo engaphezulu nesihlukanisi ezihlukile (njengo-2/3) ingakahlolwa, awukwazi ukusho 'kuhlala kunjalo'.

y-m-16-01.s.s2.st.1.o.a: Shintsha ‘noma iyiphi inombolo’ ibe ‘inombolo engeyona u-0’
y-m-16-01.s.s2.st.1.r.a: Ngolwazi olusha uthole ububanzi lapho isitatimende silungile khona futhi wengeze umbandela esitatimendeni.

y-m-16-01.s.s2.st.1.r.b: Uma isiphindaphindi singu-0 isisho asikwazi ukwakhiwa, kodwa isitatimende sithi ‘noma iyiphi inombolo,’ ngakho asilungile. Kumele usho ngqo ububanzi lapho isitatimende silungile khona.
y-m-16-01.s.s2.st.1.o.c: U-0 akasebenzi, ngakho sho ukuthi le ndlela iyindlela engeke isetshenziswe
y-m-16-01.s.s2.st.1.r.c: Ngaphandle kuka-0, zonke izibonelo zangaphambilini zazilungile. Ukulahla yonke indlela kuyadlulela.
y-m-16-01.s.s2.st.1.o.d: Engeza ukuthi uma isiphindaphindi singu-0, isiphumo siba ngu-0
y-m-16-01.s.s2.st.1.r.d: Uma uphindaphinda ngo-0, isihlukanisi naso siba ngu-0, ngakho awukwazi ukuthola isiphumo. Isiphumo asibi ngu-0.
y-m-16-01.s.s2.st.2.info: Kulokhu umfowenu omncane noma udadewenu omncane kaHajun uphindaphinde isahlukaniswa 4.8 ngo-100 nesihlukanisi 0.6 ngo-10. Saba ngu-480 ÷ 6 = 80, ngakho isiphumo besingeyona u-8.
y-m-16-01.s.s2.st.2.ask: Ingabe igama elithi ‘ufanayo’ esitatimendeni sikaHajun liyadingeka ngempela?
y-m-16-01.s.s2.st.2.after: Uma izinombolo eziphindaphindwe ezinombolweni ezimbili zihlukile, isiphumo siyashintsha (480 ÷ 6 = 80). Ngakho isitatimende siba ‘uma uphindaphinda zombili izinombolo ngenombolo efanayo engeyona u-0, isiphumo sihlala sifana.’
y-m-16-01.s.s2.st.2.o.a: Liyadingeka. Uma izinombolo eziphindaphindwe ezinombolweni ezimbili zihlukile, isiphumo singashintsha
y-m-16-01.s.s2.st.2.r.a: Uthole isizathu sokuthi ‘ufanayo’ uyadingeka kusukela esibonelweni lapho iziphindaphindi zihlukile.
y-m-16-01.s.s2.st.2.r.b: 480 ÷ 6 empeleni ngu-80. Ngaphambi kokusola iphutha, bala futhi wena.
y-m-16-01.s.s2.st.2.o.c: Alidingeki. Uma uphindaphinda kuphela ngezinombolo ezingezona u-0, isiphumo siyafana noma ngabe uphindaphinda kanjani
y-m-16-01.s.s2.st.2.r.c: Izibonelo zangaphambilini bekuyizimo lapho inombolo efanayo iphindaphindwa kuzo zombili. Isibonelo lapho kuphindaphindwa ngezinombolo ezihlukile sivela okokuqala manje.
y-m-16-01.s.s2.st.2.o.d: Liyadingeka. Kodwa lapho inombolo ephindaphindwe esihlukanisini inkulu, isiphumo siba sikhulu nakakhulu
y-m-16-01.s.s2.st.2.r.d: Uma wenza isihlukanisi sibe sikhulu, isiphumo siba sincane. Cabanga ngo-4.8 ÷ 6, lapho isihlukanisi kuphela siphindaphindwa ngo-10.

y-m-16-06.title: Ukubhala kabusha isaziso mayelana nokuhlukanisa ufulawa ngokulinganayo
y-m-16-06.topic: Ukuhlukanisa amadesimali: ukunquma indawo uma ingxenye isetshenziswa njengesilinganiso
y-m-16-06.goal: Nquma ukuthi ingxenye engapheli kufanele ibhalwe ukuya endaweni yiphi, ukuze ifanele izimo zesimo (amamaki esikali, inani elisele), bese ubhala kabusha isaziso ukuze umuntu ozoyithola akwazi ukuyiqonda.
y-m-16-06.material:
Emncintiswaneni wokupheka, ufulawa ongu-7 kg kufanele wahlukaniswe ngokulinganayo phakathi kwamaqembu angu-3. Isikali sikala kuze kube ngu-0.01 kg (10 g). 7 ÷ 3 ngu-2.3333…, ongapheli. Ufulawa osele ngemva kokuba iqembu ngalinye lithathe elalo uthathwa umsizi onesibopho. Umsizi uMina ubhale uhlaka lwesaziso.
Uhlaka: “Iqembu ngalinye, sicela uthathe ufulawa ongu-2.3 kg.”
